policy.subject: Bash-created pipeline; separate inherited control channels
policy.files: one owned out file per case

records.name: pipefail-false-later-pipe-write-false
records.source:
set +o pipefail
{ printf pipe; printf 'START
' >&8; IFS= read -r permit <&9; ready=1; for ((attempt=0;attempt<100000;attempt++)); do read -t0 -u1 value; ready=$?; ((ready==0)) && break; done; printf 'READY:%s
' "$ready" >&8; printf a >&3;  } 3>out | { IFS= read -r -N4 payload; printf 'STOP
' >&8; }
printf 'STATUS:%s VECTOR:%s
' "$?" "${PIPESTATUS[*]}"
